notes: Breadth-first search from every village with its own distance and parent lists; a road to an already reached village that is not the parent closes a ring of dist + dist + 1 roads, and the smallest over all starts is the shortest ring. Searching from village 0 alone overestimates rings it does not lie on and never sees a ring it cannot reach.

traps: the shortest ring is not the one nearest to village 0
a ring in a part of the map village 0 cannot reach
a road back to where you came from is not a ring
